controls.zh: 点击「翘前轮特技」或按空格抬起前轮；点击「投喂小鱼」触发喉囊反馈，点击车灯开关灯光。原界面为中文，音效默认关闭。
controls.en: Click the wheelie button (翘前轮特技) or press Space to lift the front wheel; poke the fish (投喂小鱼) for pouch feedback, and toggle the headlight (车灯). Original controls are in Chinese; sound is off by default.

controls.zh: WASD / 方向键控制骑行，拖动和滚轮调整视角。
controls.en: Use WASD / arrow keys to ride; drag and scroll to adjust the view.

controls.zh: 点击开始骑行，切换跟随、环绕、侧面与鹈鹕视角；拖动旋转视角。
controls.en: Start the ride, choose chase, orbit, side or pelican views, and drag to rotate.

controls.zh: 点击开始骑行，切换跟随、环绕、侧面与鹈鹕视角；拖动旋转视角。
controls.en: Start the ride, choose chase, orbit, side or pelican views, and drag to rotate.

controls.zh: 拖动调整三维视角，滚轮缩放，重置视角并调节骑行速度。
controls.en: Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, reset the view and change the cycling speed.

controls.zh: 拖动旋转三维视角，滚轮或双指缩放。
controls.en: Drag to rotate the 3D view; scroll or pinch to zoom.

controls.zh: 点击「湖面捕鱼」使鱼跳入喉囊并增加计数，点击「鸣笛张嘴」或鸟身触发鸣笛；拖动「骑行速度」，切换「晴日／黄昏／星夜」。交互后原作会合成音效。
controls.en: Click Catch Fish (湖面捕鱼) to catch a fish and increase the count; click Honk (鸣笛张嘴) or the bird to honk. Drag the riding-speed slider and choose day, sunset or night. The original generates sound effects after interaction.

controls.zh: 点击「投喂鲜鱼」（或空格）捕鱼，「按响喇叭」（或 B）鸣笛；切换晴日／黄昏／星夜及帽子，拖动速度滑块或选择驻车／悠闲／巡航／冲刺。原作交互会合成音效，可点音效按钮静音。
controls.en: Click 投喂鲜鱼 or press Space to catch fish; click 按响喇叭 or press B to honk. Switch day/sunset/night and headwear, or change speed with the slider/presets. Original controls are Chinese. Interactions synthesize sound; use the sound button to mute.
